verdict.rationale: OpenAI's Batch API docs state that asynchronous groups of requests cost 50% less, with a separate pool of higher rate limits and a 24-hour turnaround. The pricing docs include a dedicated batch price section, and the changelog lists Batch among flagship model capabilities. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the batch discount is realized in practice.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: send asynchronous groups of requests with 50% lower costs, a separate pool of significantly higher rate limits, and a clear 24-hour turnaround time
plus batch and fine-tuning price sections
